literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiyou day, paid respects at the ancestral mausoleum.
idiomatic: On jiyou day of the tenth winter month the court paid respects at the ancestral mausoleum.

literal: On gengshen day paid respects at the Abdication Emperor's and Shizong's temples.
idiomatic: On gengshen day the court paid respects at the Abdication Emperor's and Shizong's temples.

literal: On xinyou day libation was offered at the Jade Hall.
idiomatic: On xinyou day libation was offered at the Jade Hall.

literal: Eleventh month, on bingzi day, made Left yilibi Xiao Molu Khitan mobile palace deployment director.
idiomatic: On bingzi day of the eleventh month Left yilibi Xiao Molu was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director.

literal: On gengzi day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On gengzi day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Twelfth month, on gengxu day, forbidden officials to lend or trade within their jurisdictions.
idiomatic: On gengxu day of the twelfth month officials were forbidden to lend or trade within their jurisdictions.

literal: On wuchen day the Grand Empress Dowager fell ill; partial amnesty for prisoners within five hundred li of the imperial halt.
idiomatic: On wuchen day the Grand Empress Dowager fell ill; partial amnesty for prisoners within five hundred li of the imperial halt.

literal: On jisi day the Grand Empress Dowager died.
idiomatic: On jisi day the Grand Empress Dowager died.

literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on renshen new moon, envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning to Song and Xia.
idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the renshen new moon of the first spring month envoys were dispatched to announce the mourning to Song and Xia.

literal: Went to the Duck River to fish.
idiomatic: The court went to the Duck River to fish.

literal: On guiyou day Song dispatched envoys presenting a painted likeness of the Song ruler.
idiomatic: On guiyou day Song sent envoys presenting a painted likeness of the Song ruler.

literal: On dinghai day Yelü Pode, who administered Yi Prefecture, completed his term; the people of his district begged he remain; permitted.
idiomatic: On dinghai day Yelü Pode, who administered Yi Prefecture, completed his term; the people of his district begged he remain; permission was granted.

literal: Second month, on bingwu day, edict to the yilibi: for capital offenses in all routes, though the case was complete, still order another prefecture or district to review; if there was no injustice, then decide;
idiomatic: On bingwu day of the second month an edict to the yilibi ordered that for capital offenses in all routes, though the case was complete, another prefecture or district was still to review; if there was no injustice, then decide;

literal: whoever claimed injustice was immediately to be memorialized in full.
idiomatic: whoever claimed injustice was immediately to be memorialized in full.

literal: On gengxu day went to Yuer Marsh.
idiomatic: On gengxu day the court went to Yuer Marsh.

literal: Third month, on wuyin day, recruited the bold and swift from Tiande, Zhenwu, Dongsheng, and other places and registered them as troops.
idiomatic: On wuyin day of the third month the bold and swift were recruited from Tiande, Zhenwu, Dongsheng, and other places and registered as troops.

literal: On jiawu day a general amnesty was proclaimed.
idiomatic: On jiawu day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiachen day, paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On jiachen day of the fourth summer month the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

literal: On dingmao day Song dispatched envoys to offer condolences.
idiomatic: On dingmao day Song sent envoys to offer condolences.

literal: Fifth month, on gengwu new moon, posthumous honorific for the late Grand Empress Dowager: Empress Qin'ai.
idiomatic: On the gengwu new moon of the fifth month the posthumous honorific for the late Grand Empress Dowager was Empress Qin'ai.

literal: On guiyou day buried at Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On guiyou day burial was at Qing Mausoleum.

literal: Xia State and Goryeo dispatched envoys to attend.
idiomatic: Xia State and Goryeo sent envoys to attend.

literal: On yiyou day went to Yongan Mountain to escape summer heat.
idiomatic: On yiyou day the court went to Yongan Mountain to escape summer heat.

literal: Sixth month, on chou day, Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Zheng Xiao Ge was made Southern Court privy commissioner, transferred to Prince of Chu; Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wu Renxian was made Northern Court privy commissioner.
idiomatic: On chou day of the sixth month Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Zheng Xiao Ge was made Southern Court privy commissioner and transferred to Prince of Chu; Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wu Renxian was made Northern Court privy commissioner.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinsi day, regulated that officials in charge of the inner treasury who stole two strings of cash or more might be reported by slaves and maidservants.
idiomatic: On xinsi day of the seventh autumn month it was regulated that officials in charge of the inner treasury who stole two strings of cash or more might be reported by slaves and maidservants.

literal: On renwu day hunted at Heiling.
idiomatic: On renwu day the court hunted at Heiling.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuxu new moon, associate Eastern Capital regent Hougu was made Southern Court great king; Bao'an Army military commissioner Xidi was made great king of the Xi Six Tribes.
idiomatic: On the wuxu new moon of the tenth winter month associate Eastern Capital regent Hougu was made Southern Court great king; Bao'an Army military commissioner Xidi was made great king of the Xi Six Tribes.

literal: Eleventh month, on guiyou day performed the rebirth and firewood-bundle rituals; ministers were feasted at Bafang Marsh.
idiomatic: On guiyou day of the eleventh month the rebirth and firewood-bundle rituals were performed; ministers were feasted at Bafang Marsh.

literal: On gengchen day at Clear Wind Hall received the great investiture ritual.
idiomatic: On gengchen day at Clear Wind Hall the great investiture ritual was received.

literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed.
idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: Prince of Wu Renxian was made Nanjing deputy grand marshal; transferred to Prince of Sui.
idiomatic: Prince of Wu Renxian was made Nanjing deputy grand marshal and transferred to Prince of Sui.

literal: On renwu day paid respects at Taizu's and the various emperors' palaces.
idiomatic: On renwu day the court paid respects at Taizu's and the various emperors' palaces.

literal: On bingxu day sacrificed at Muye Mountain.
idiomatic: On bingxu day sacrifice was made at Muye Mountain.

literal: Forbidden manufacture of jade vessels.
idiomatic: Manufacture of jade vessels was forbidden.

literal: Twelfth month, on xinchou day, relaxed the prohibition on tuoni and otter-fur coats.
idiomatic: On xinchou day of the twelfth month the prohibition on tuoni and otter-fur coats was relaxed.

literal: On yisi day permitted scholars and commoners to keep hawks.
idiomatic: On yisi day scholars and commoners were permitted to keep hawks.

literal: On xinhai day Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Chu Xiao Ge again became Northern Court privy commissioner.
idiomatic: On xinhai day Southern Court privy commissioner Prince of Chu Xiao Ge again became Northern Court privy commissioner.

literal: Intercalary month, on jisi day, granted the imperial uncle Chongyuan a gold tally.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jisi day, the imperial uncle Chongyuan was granted a gold tally.

literal: That year the imperial son Jun was born.
idiomatic: That year the imperial son Jun was born.

literal: In the fifth year, spring, went to Chun Prefecture.
idiomatic: In the fifth year, in spring, the court went to Chun Prefecture.

literal: Summer, sixth month, on jiazi new moon, halted at Nage Marsh.
idiomatic: On the jiazi new moon of the sixth summer month the court halted at Nage Marsh.

literal: On jichou day Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Asu was made Northern Court chancellor; associate privy commissioner Yelü Yixin Southern Court privy commissioner; tiyin Chage Liaoxing Army military commissioner; Prince of Lu Xiejianu Wuding Army military commissioner; Eastern Capital regent Prince of Wu Tiebu Western Capital regent.
idiomatic: On jichou day Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Asu was made Northern Court chancellor; associate privy commissioner Yelü Yixin Southern Court privy commissioner; tiyin Chage Liaoxing Army military commissioner; Prince of Lu Xiejianu Wuding Army military commissioner; Eastern Capital regent Prince of Wu Tiebu Western Capital regent.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on dingyou day, Wugu Dilie detail-stable Xiao Molu was made Left yilibi.
idiomatic: On dingyou day of the seventh autumn month Wugu Dilie detail-stable Xiao Molu was made Left yilibi.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on renzi new moon, visited Nanjing and sacrificed to Xingzong at Jianing Hall.
idiomatic: On the renzi new moon of the tenth winter month the court visited Nanjing and sacrificed to Xingzong at Jianing Hall.

literal: Eleventh month, hunting was forbidden.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month hunting was forbidden.

literal: Twelfth month, on renxu day, Northern Court linya Xima Liu was made Right yilibi; Associate Administrator of Affairs Wu Zhan, because his younger brother Xun had fraudulently entered the service register, was stripped of rank and made a commoner.
idiomatic: On renxu day of the twelfth month Northern Court linya Xima Liu was made Right yilibi; Associate Administrator of Affairs Wu Zhan, because his younger brother Xun had fraudulently entered the service register, was stripped of rank and made a commoner.

literal: That year at the Hundred Blessings Hall the jinshi Liang Yuan and one hundred fifteen others were passed.
idiomatic: That year at the Hundred Blessings Hall the jinshi Liang Yuan and one hundred fifteen others were passed.

literal: In the sixth year, spring, went to Yuanyang Marsh.
idiomatic: In the sixth year, in spring, the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.

literal: Summer, fifth month, on wuzi new moon, compiler of the national history Yelü Bai requested compilation of the Emperor's poems and rhapsodies and was ordered to write the preface.
idiomatic: On the wuzi new moon of the fifth summer month compiler of the national history Yelü Bai requested compilation of the Emperor's poems and rhapsodies and was ordered to write the preface.

literal: On jiyou day halted at Nage Marsh.
idiomatic: On jiyou day the court halted at Nage Marsh.

literal: Sixth month, on wuwu new moon, Northeast Route Jurchen detail-stable Gaojianu was made tiyin.
idiomatic: On the wuwu new moon of the sixth month Northeast Route Jurchen detail-stable Gaojianu was made tiyin.

literal: On renxu day dispatched envoys to review prisoners.
idiomatic: On renxu day envoys were dispatched to review prisoners.

literal: On bingyin day the Directorate of Education was established at the Central Capital; ordered seasonal sacrifice to the Former Sage and Former Teacher; on guimao day Prince of Sui Renxian was made Northern Court great king and granted an imperial drafting edict.
idiomatic: On bingyin day the Directorate of Education was established at the Central Capital and seasonal sacrifice to the Former Sage and Former Teacher was ordered; on guimao day Prince of Sui Renxian was made Northern Court great king and granted an imperial drafting edict.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiazi day, halted at Ousi Marsh.
idiomatic: On jiazi day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

literal: In the seventh year, spring, third month, on gengxu day, went to Chun Prefecture.
idiomatic: In the seventh year, on gengxu day of the third spring month the court went to Chun Prefecture.

literal: Yelü Yixin was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.
idiomatic: Yelü Yixin was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinwei day, forbidden officials and commoners to keep eastern-sea green falcons.
idiomatic: On xinwei day of the fourth summer month officials and commoners were forbidden to keep eastern-sea green falcons.

literal: Fifth month, on bingxu day, summered at Yongan Mountain.
idiomatic: On bingxu day of the fifth month the court summered at Yongan Mountain.

literal: On bingwu day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On bingwu day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

literal: On xinhai day Eastern Capital regent Prince of Chen Xiao Ala was killed.
idiomatic: On xinhai day Eastern Capital regent Prince of Chen Xiao Ala was killed.

literal: Sixth month, on renzi new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
idiomatic: On the renzi new moon of the sixth month there was a solar eclipse.

literal: On jiazi day Xiao Molu was made military commissioner of Shunyi Army.
idiomatic: On jiazi day Xiao Molu was made military commissioner of Shunyi Army.

literal: On dingmao day visited Hongyi, Yongxing, and Chongde palaces to perform sacrifice.
idiomatic: On dingmao day the court visited Hongyi, Yongxing, and Chongde palaces to perform sacrifice.

literal: Willow-shooting; a feast was granted; rewards by degree.
idiomatic: Willow-shooting was held; a feast was granted and rewards by degree.

literal: On wuchen day performed the rebirth ritual; again ordered ministers to shoot willows in separate teams.
idiomatic: On wuchen day the rebirth ritual was performed; ministers were again ordered to shoot willows in separate teams.

literal: On dingchou day Prince of Chu Nielugu was made to administer Southern Court privy affairs.
idiomatic: On dingchou day Prince of Chu Nielugu was made to administer Southern Court privy affairs.

literal: Autumn, ninth month, on dingchou day, halted at Ousi Marsh.
idiomatic: On dingchou day of the ninth autumn month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

literal: Winter, twelfth month, on renwu day, Yelü Alizhi, who administered Huanglong Prefecture, was made Southern Court great king.
idiomatic: On renwu day of the twelfth winter month Yelü Alizhi, who administered Huanglong Prefecture, was made Southern Court great king.
